# anthropic_deployment (Data Source)

Reads one Managed Agents deployment. Mounted-resource secrets are never returned.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_deployment" "nightly" {
  id = "depl_01ExampleDeployId00000000"
}

output "next_runs" {
  value = data.anthropic_deployment.nightly.upcoming_runs_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Deployment id (`depl_...`).

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) Agent id.
- `agent_version` (Number) Pinned agent version.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `budget_max_list_cost_cents` (String) Per-run budget in USD cents; null when uncapped.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment id.
- `last_run_at` (String) Timestamp of the last run.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `paused_reason_type` (String) `manual` or `error` when paused.
- `schedule_cron_expression` (String) Cron expression; null for manual-only deployments.
- `schedule_timezone` (String) Schedule timezone.
- `status` (String) `active` or `paused`.
- `upcoming_runs_at` (List of String) Next scheduled runs.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `vault_ids` (List of String) Vault ids.
